name: How long does custom trim installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom trim installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the room count, trim type, and how much prep is needed. A small trim repair may take part of a day, while whole-home trim or custom feature work can take several days, especially if finishing, paint touch-ups, or drywall repair are involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small repairs can take a few hours, while multi-room or custom projects may take several days. Prep work, finishing, and touch-ups are what usually extend the timeline.
